card.name: The Shallow Grave
card.officialText: Each player targets 1 monster in their own GY; each player Special Summons the target from their GY in face-down Defense Position.

behavior.activation: Active representative Main Phase only; Normal Spell must be in that physical player's hand.
behavior.targets: One activation-time target per team from that team's shared Graveyard.
behavior.resolution: Each target is independently revalidated with TargetBinding zone+epoch; a stale target does not cancel the other team's summon.
behavior.summon: Face-down Defense Position; three shared Monster Zones per team.
behavior.ownership: Physical owner seat is retained from UID while control follows the Graveyard team.
behavior.idempotency: JSON-persisted activationId; replay blocked after resolution or negation.
